records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts:5 — The public mutation accepts duplicate guest emails even though the only bundled caller enforces uniqueness, so non-UI callers can create duplicate attendees or trigger a persistence failure.
records.rationale: The diff's server-side ZAddGuestsInputSchema is only z.object({ bookingId, guests: z.array(z.string().email()) }) with no uniqueness refine, while the UI's ZAddGuestsInputSchema adds a unique-emails refine. Whether this causes duplicates or a DB error depends on the schema's unique constraint, which is not visible here, so confidence is moderate but the validation asymmetry is verifiable in the diff.
